title: Sr. Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Applications
Staff AI Engineer, Developer Relations Engineering
description_html:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About the Role:

Crusoe is hiring an AI Engineer for our Developer Relations Engineering team: an engineer who builds agentic AI systems and enjoys showing other developers how they work. You will build reference agents, open-source integrations, and sample applications on Crusoe Cloud and Crusoe Managed Inference.



In this role, you will lead technical content creation, community engagement, and developer outreach across AI infrastructure and managed services workloads. You will produce documentation, tutorials, white papers, sample applications, and video guides.



You will partner with the Product, Engineering, Research, and GTM/Solutions Engineering teams and work across the open-source agent ecosystem.



You will spend most of your time building and then sharing what you build.



What You'll Be Working On:

 - Agentic Reference Systems: Architect and ship end-to-end reference agents and starter kits on Crusoe that developers can use as a starting point for production, covering tool use, MCP, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, structured outputs, memory, and evals.

 - Examples & Documentation: Own the code examples, tutorials, and documentation that help developers go from first API call to working agent, and keep them tested and up to date as the ecosystem changes.

 - Open Source & GitHub: Own Crusoe's developer-facing GitHub presence, including examples, cookbooks, and integrations. Contribute upstream to agent frameworks, inference engines, and developer tooling (for example LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, the OpenAI Agents SDK, MCP, vLLM, and SGLang) so they work well with Crusoe.

 - Technical Content & Video: Turn the systems you build into content developers rely on: deep-dive blog posts, notebooks, YouTube videos, livestreams, and short technical clips.

 - Building in Public: Share your work on X, LinkedIn, YouTube, Discord, Reddit, Hacker News, etc. Answer technical questions, review community projects, and become a trusted technical voice in the agent and open-source community.

 - Use-Case Blueprints: Partner with GTM/Solutions Engineering to spot recurring customer patterns and turn them into open reference architectures for developer segments such as Physical AI, robotics, simulation, and other industry verticals.

 - Product & Research Partnership: Join Product, Engineering, and Research workflows. Test features and models before launch, make sure samples and docs are ready on launch day, and bring developer friction back as concrete product input, following each issue until it is fixed or explicitly deprioritized.

 - Talks & Workshops: Give technical talks, live demos, and hands-on labs at conferences, meetups, hackathons, and workshops.



What You'll Bring to the Team:

 - Engineering Experience: 5+ years as a software engineer, ML engineer, applied AI engineer, forward-deployed engineer, or in a similar hands-on engineering role, with strong Python. A Developer Relations title is not required.

 - Engineering Credibility: Ability to earn credibility with both AI infrastructure engineers and ML/AI engineers.

 - Agentic AI: Hands-on experience building LLM applications and agents with tool calling, MCP, retrieval, memory, and evaluation, using one or more frameworks such as LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, or the OpenAI Agents SDK. You have well-formed opinions about what works and what breaks in production.

 - Cloud Infrastructure: Experience working with cloud computing platforms (such as AWS, GCP, or Azure) or managed AI solutions, with a foundational understanding of cloud infrastructure concepts.

 - Inference & Model Serving: Working knowledge of how models are served, including OpenAI-compatible APIs, open-weight models, and serving engines such as vLLM or SGLang. You can explain cost and latency tradeoffs credibly.

 - Public Track Record: Evidence of sharing technical work in public through GitHub repos, open-source contributions, blog posts, videos, talks, or an active technical presence on social platforms. Please include links when you apply.

 - Technical Communication: Strong communication skills across written and verbal formats, including technical documentation, white papers, video explainers, and presentation decks.

 - Ownership & Collaboration: You work well across teams, set your own priorities, and ship in a fast-moving environment.

 - Travel Requirement: Ability to travel up to 20%.

 - Education: Bachelor's/Master's/PhD degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.



Bonus Points

 - Maintainer or significant contributor to an open-source AI, agent, or inference project

 - Experience producing technical video content such as YouTube tutorials, livestreams, or screencasts

 - Experience fine-tuning or post-training open-weight models (SFT/RL/LoRA)

 - An existing technical audience that trusts your views on models, agents, and tooling



Benefits:

 - Competitive compensation and equity packages

 - Restricted Stock Units

 - Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

 - Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

 - Employer contributions to HSA account

 - Paid parental leave

 - Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

 - Professional development & tuition reimbursement

 - Mental health & wellness support

 - Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

 - Cell phone stipend

 - 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

 - Volunteer time off

 - Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

 - Daily meals allowance

 - Additional perks & programs specific to location



Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $180,000-$220,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.



Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

title: Senior AI Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineering
description_html: Join the AI & Automation Supply Chain Business Transformations team in NVIDIA Operations to build the next generation of decision intelligence for our supply chain on Palantir Foundry and AIP. As a Senior AI Engineer and Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work directly with planners and supply-chain experts to turn their decision logic into production applications: governed data pipelines, Ontology models, analytical functions, operational interfaces and AI agents that are trusted, tested and used every day. This is a rare opportunity to shape how one of the world's most advanced AI companies runs its own supply chain. If you thrive at the intersection of Palantir engineering, applied AI and supply-chain transformation, join us.    What you will be doing:    Build and own production supply-chain applications on Palantir Foundry and AIP, including data pipelines, Ontology models (object, link and action types), analytical functions, operational interfaces (Workshop and OSDK) and controlled actions.    Work directly with supply-chain planners and experts to convert business rules, constraints and exception procedures into documented, versioned and testable software.    Combine analytical methods, optimization and language models to support operational decisions, selecting the approach that meets each use case's correctness, reliability and performance requirements.    Own automated testing and validation across application code, data pipelines, business rules and agent workflows. Establish acceptance criteria with domain experts and enforce checks before release.    Use AI coding tools effectively while remaining accountable for code quality: review generated code, validate assumptions and verify behavior against independently defined expected results.    Build evaluation datasets from approved scenarios and historical decisions. Test edge cases, repeatability, permissions, failure recovery and changes to models, prompts, tools and data.    Define agent autonomy boundaries, human-in-the-loop workflows and escalation strategies for enterprise supply-chain use cases built on AIP.    Measure operational results, including decision cycle time, manual effort, exception resolution and decision quality. Capture user corrections and outcomes to guide improvements.    Capture design requirements, translate them into user stories, lead technical design reviews and documentation, drive end-to-end integration testing and support UAT and hyper care.     What we need to see:    Demonstrated hands-on production delivery on Palantir Foundry and AIP: Python or Pipeline Builder transforms, Ontology design (object, link and action types), Workshop or OSDK applications, AIP Logic and Functions, and Data Connection sources, with ownership after go-live.    Working knowledge of Foundry governance and release management: projects and roles, markings, branching, and environment promotion across development, UAT and production.    Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent experience).    12+ years of demonstrable experience in software architecture, systems design or enterprise platform engineering.    Strong Python and SQL development skills, with experience integrating enterprise systems (ERP, planning, ITSM) through APIs, data connectors or custom services.    Proven ability to implement complex business rules and explain how their correctness was established.    Strong automated testing, debugging and release practices, including validation of AI-assisted development and LLM-based workflows.    Practical experience integrating and evaluating language models, including open models such as NVIDIA Nemotron.    Ability to work directly with operational users, resolve ambiguous requirements and deliver maintainable software.    Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex designs clearly and build trusted partnerships across technical and business audiences.     Ways to stand out from the crowd:    Supply-chain, manufacturing, planning or operations research experience.    Experience with constraint optimization, simulation and scenario analysis.    TypeScript development and advanced Palantir application development.    Experience with agentic frameworks and patterns (RAG pipelines, multi-agent orchestration, vector search) and with NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails or GPU-optimized inference stacks.    Hands-on experience with containerized deployments, Kubernetes and hybrid cloud/on-prem environments and evidence of measurable improvements from systems used in daily operations.    NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and creative people in the world working here! If you are driven by impact, passionate about enterprise AI, and inspired to shape decision intelligence for NVIDIA's Supply Chain Operations, we want to hear from you. Apply today!     Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary range for this position is 200,000 USD – 322,000 USD.           You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits .           Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 6, 2026.   This posting is for an existing vacancy.   NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.   NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer - Builder Platform
description_html:
ROLE SUMMARY

Join our Builder Platform Team as a Senior Staff Software Engineer. Our mission is to empower a company of builders by delivering a frictionless, standardized, and governed platform for agents, workflows, and core engineering tools. We operate Temporal as customer zero: we partner directly with teams across the company to run their real work on the platform, measure the productivity it unlocks, and feed what we learn back into Temporal’s products and open-source frameworks our customers can adopt.

This is a company-level technical leadership role spanning Agents & Workflows, AI Infrastructure, Developer Infrastructure, and Productivity Engineering. You will set the multi-year technical direction for the platform, align teams around clear architectural boundaries and standards, and lead major cross-functional initiatives from ambiguous opportunity through durable adoption and measurable impact.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Set and communicate a multi-year technical vision for the Builder Platform, translating company strategy into an executable portfolio across Agents & Workflows, AI Infrastructure, Developer Infrastructure, and Productivity Engineering.

 - Lead the architecture and evolution of our Agent Platform, the shared foundation teams across Temporal use to deploy, run, evaluate, govern, and improve their agents and agentic workflows.

 - Establish and operate our AI Infrastructure, the LLM and MCP gateways every agent and workflow at Temporal runs through, with guardrails, fallback, usage and cost controls, model rollout policies, and clear SLOs.

 - Implement AI Governance in partnership with Security, Legal, and IT, turning policy into practical controls, approved patterns, and auditability without creating unnecessary barriers.

 - Architect the agents and workflows that carry engineering work from issue to production and business work from trigger to outcome, and decide which patterns graduate into shared platform capabilities and which stay with the teams that own them.

 - Own the technical strategy for our Developer Infrastructure (Source Control and CI) and developer tools, including repository standards, access and ownership models, reusable workflows, and CI reliability and cost.

 - Partner with leaders across Engineering, Product, Sales, and G&A to identify where AI can accelerate work and improve outcomes, and prioritize those opportunities into a company-wide portfolio.

 - Standardize how Temporal adopts agents and agentic tooling (best practices, paved roads, and enablement), driving adoption across the organization through influence rather than mandate.

 - Define clear architectural and organizational boundaries across the platform (what is centralized, standardized as a paved road, federated to teams, purchased, or deliberately not built) and make the hard tradeoffs among speed, flexibility, reliability, security, cost, and long-term maintainability.

 - Measure the platform on outcomes (adoption, velocity, reliability, and cost), with feedback loops that quantify the productivity it unlocks and shape the portfolio.

 - Own our customer-zero strategy: turn what we learn into validated requirements for Temporal Cloud, the SDKs, and our Agent Harness, drive the feedback loop with product leadership, lead our open-source reference architecture for customer platform teams, and represent the strategy with customers, partners, and the broader technical community.

 - Develop senior technical leaders, create alignment among engineering leads and managers, and make teams more effective without relying on direct authority.

 - Participate in on-call rotation while leading systemic improvements that reduce operational burden, address risks before they become company-wide problems, and improve the internal user experience.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals and a track record of setting technical direction and delivering major platform initiatives across multiple engineering teams.

 - Experience leveraging modern agentic coding tools such as Codex and Claude Code, including defining company-wide best practices and driving adoption across the organization.

 - Proficiency in one or more programming languages commonly used at Temporal, such as Go, TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, or Java, with deep expertise in at least one relevant domain (developer infrastructure, distributed systems, AI platforms, or platform engineering) and proficiency across several others.

 - Experience building and operating internal platforms, developer infrastructure, or agent platforms adopted across a company.

 - Strong judgment in platform-boundary decisions (what to centralize, federate, standardize, buy, or deliberately avoid building) and in tradeoffs among speed, flexibility, reliability, security, cost, and long-term maintainability.

 - Demonstrated ability to influence engineering managers, senior individual contributors, Security, Legal, IT, Product, and business stakeholders, and to turn ambiguous company objectives into architecture, standards, roadmaps, and coordinated execution.

 - Experience defining outcome-oriented metrics for developer productivity or AI systems (adoption, reliability, quality, cost, and cycle time) and using them to steer a portfolio.

 - Clear written communication, including documentation and technical strategy that enable self-service and align teams across the company.

 - Experience establishing governance through paved roads rather than documentation or approval processes alone.

 - Evidence of making other technical leaders and teams more effective through mentorship, architectural clarity, and consensus building.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience building internal agents and operating an agent platform.

 - Experience building and operating Temporal applications.

 - Experience defining or implementing AI governance, model-access infrastructure, or agent evaluation systems.

 - Experience managing GitHub configuration, policy, and workflows at organizational scale

 - Familiarity with developer productivity measurement frameworks such as SPACE and DORA metrics.

Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Temporal Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.

title: Software Engineer
description_html: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.      Job Category  Software Engineering    Job Details        About Salesforce     Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.    Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.   Applications will be accepted until 11/06/2026.       About The Opportunity      Contentful is looking for a Software Engineer to join our Applied AI product line with a primary focus on Marketplace. In this role, you will help build, maintain, and grow the systems, apps, and workflows that expand what customers can do with Contentful.      You will work across the Marketplace surface area and adjacent Applied AI tooling, helping us deliver high-impact apps, improve the contribution and review pipeline, and scale the ways internal and external developers build on top of Contentful. While Marketplace is the primary focus, this role should also be able to contribute across adjacent Applied AI areas like Extensibility and Developer Experience when priorities call for it.      This role is ideal for an engineer strong in front-end product work but not limited to it: someone comfortable moving between React surfaces, Node.js services, APIs, developer tooling, and production operations as needed. We are looking for a product-minded full-stack engineer who enjoys strong cross-functional collaboration and taking growing ownership of software through its full lifecycle in production.      We are also evolving how we build software. We increasingly use AI-assisted development workflows to accelerate delivery, reduce menial workload, and improve leverage across the software development lifecycle. We are looking for an engineer who is genuinely excited to experiment with these tools — not just adopt them passively, but bring strong engineering instincts to getting the most out of them.   This is a hybrid role, with office attendance in Denver expected 2 days per week (Tuesday, Thursday).        What To Expect?       Design, build, and maintain Marketplace features, apps, and supporting services that improve the experience for both app builders and app installers.      Contribute to the systems and tooling that help Contentful teams and partners bring new apps and integrations to market faster.      Contribute across adjacent Applied AI problem spaces, including extensibility workflows, developer tooling, internal platform capabilities, and backend services that support developers building on Contentful.      Improve contribution workflows, trust and safety checks, maintainability, and operational quality across Marketplace and Applied AI surfaces.      Partner closely with product, design, and engineers across Applied AI to shape solutions that solve meaningful customer and business problems.      Help generalize, polish, and productionize internally built apps and Applied AI contributions so they can be supported long-term by Marketplace Engineering.      Own software in production, including debugging issues, improving observability, strengthening reliability, and participating in support and operational responsibilities.      Use AI-assisted workflows across planning, implementation, debugging, and documentation where they create real leverage.      Help the team improve how we use AI in engineering by sharing practices, refining workflows, and contributing to a healthy engineering culture around quality and speed.       What You Need To Be Successful       Roughly 4-7 years of relevant software engineering experience      Solid professional software engineering experience building and maintaining production systems.      Strong experience with TypeScript and Node.js, plus solid experience building user-facing product surfaces in React or similar front-end frameworks.      Clear strength in front-end engineering, paired with real comfort contributing to backend services, APIs, and developer-facing tooling rather than working exclusively in the UI layer.      Experience designing and evolving APIs, integrations, and services used by other engineers, partners, or customers.      Good judgment around reliability, maintainability, security, and technical tradeoffs in a product environment.      Comfort working across the stack and across boundaries, from user experience to backend behavior to operational concerns. title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure Engineering
Senior Software Engineer, Distributed Systems - NIM Factory
description_html: NVIDIA is the platform upon which every new AI-powered application is built. We are seeking a senior engineer to design and build factory infrastructure and automation for NVIDIA Inference Microservices (NIMs). The right person for this role brings technical drive and creativity to change the way NVIDIA optimizes and serves performant inferencing for every AI model in a heterogeneous cluster environments. Our NIM offerings are easy to use, highly performant and tested in all deployment scenarios, in the cloud, on customer’s self-hosted infrastructure and locally on all NVIDIA GPUs. You will apply your deep technical expertise to design an efficient, scalable and reliable automation factory infrastructure that will take AI models to become NIMs that are validated for best in class performance and accuracy.    NVIDIA is building a new category of products, by intersecting our prowess in deep learning and computing, with industry-leading technologies. You will harness groundbreaking technologies, and build a highly efficient factory to power how NVIDIA builds and validates NIMs for inferencing all the way through deployment in heterogeneous hardware and software environments. You will influence and drive technical advances in NVIDIAs workflows and build the infrastructure that strives to accelerate the delivery of every AI model on NVIDIA's GPUs anywhere. We are looking for technical talent to design and build our factory capabilities, including the underlying infrastructure, pipelines, backends, Docker build, test harness, metrics, performance engineering, log ingestion, and more.    What you'll be doing:     Develop a factory pipeline that will take an AI model in and produce a deployable service that is validated across Cloud, On-prem and Kubernetes environments. With the team, define and deliver rapid iterations on the group's technical strategies and roadmaps to deliver and improve the NIM factory. You will be designing interfaces, data modeling and schema design, and expanding observability over the factory pipeline and its compute infrastructure.  Work with technical leaders designing and developing scalable and reliable factory components. You will collaborate with multiple AI model teams to understand their requirements to build an efficient infrastructure that improves every teams' productivity.   Define metrics and drive improvements based on user feedback. You will mentor and collaborate throughout the team and with other teams to grow your colleagues and yourself. You will have a history of learning and growing your skills and those around you.     What we need to see:     A history of using your advanced programming skills to build distributed and compute systems, backend services, microservices and cloud technologies.  Effective experience working with multi-functional teams, principals and architects, across organizational boundaries.  Mentorship, growing teams and team members, and the flexibility to ability to adjust your direction and expectations given the needs of our customers.  Deep technical expertise in distributed containerize applications using technologies such as Docker, K8s, Cloud Endpoints, Helm, and Prometheus.   Passion for building rich, microservice applications build and test automation pipeline.  Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to lead multi-functional efforts  Proven experience debugging and analyzing the performance of distributed microservices or cloud systems.  BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related field (or equivalent experience)  8+ years of shown experience developing performant microservice, cloud software and/or tooling roles      Ways to stand out from the crowd:     Experience delivering event-driven applications using various services such as Temporal, Kafka, Redis or others and a demonstrable ability to discuss the pros and cons of these choices.  A history of building and deploying containers for Microservices, Cloud and On-prem deployments, and their associated CI/CD pipelines  Prior experience in working with large scale full stack development    We are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and creative people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous with a real passion for technology we want to hear from you.     Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary range for this position is 184,000 USD – 287,500 USD.           You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits . title: Senior Software Engineer - Builder Platform
description_html:
ROLE SUMMARY

Join our Builder Platform Team as a Senior Software Engineer. Our mission is to empower a company of builders by delivering a frictionless, standardized, and governed platform for agents, workflows, and core engineering tools. We operate Temporal as customer zero: we partner directly with teams across the company to run their real work on the platform, measure the productivity it unlocks, and feed what we learn back into Temporal’s products and an open-source frameworks our customers can adopt.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Develop and operate our Agent Platform for deploying, running, evaluating, governing, and improving agents and agentic workflows.

 - Establish and operate the AI Infrastructure that agents depend on: LLM and MCP gateways with guardrails, fallback, usage and cost controls, and model rollout policies.

 - Build and operate agents and workflows that carry engineering work from issue to production and business work from trigger to outcome, with humans governing the boundaries.

 - Own our Developer Infrastructure (Source Control and CI) and build the developer tools that improve builder flow and reduce friction across the company.

 - Partner with teams across Engineering, Product, Sales, and G&A to understand where AI could accelerate their work or improve the quality of outcomes.

 - Drive adoption of agents and agentic tooling across the company, and own the best practices and enablement materials that help builders succeed using the paved roads.

 - Build measurement and feedback loops (usage, reliability, and cost) to quantify the productivity the platform unlocks and guide the roadmap.

 - Treat Temporal as customer zero: turn what we learn into validated requirements for Temporal Cloud, the SDKs, and our Agent Harness, and contribute to an open-source reference architecture that customer platform teams can adopt.

 - Participate in on-call to support internal users.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience shipping and operating production-quality internal platforms or developer tooling.

 - Experience leveraging modern agentic coding tools such as Codex and Claude Code.

 - Proficiency in one or more programming languages commonly used at Temporal, such as Go, TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, or Java.

 - Experience building workflow automation or internal tools (CLI tools, services, GitHub automation, cloud automation, or similar).

 - Strong judgment about when to standardize versus when to enable flexibility, and how to remove friction without compromising reliability.

 - Comfort working cross-functionally, including partnering with non-traditional developers and translating needs into usable solutions.

 - Ability to use data and qualitative feedback together to prioritize and measure impact.

 - Clear written communication, including documentation that enables self-service.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience building internal agents and operating an agent platform

 - Experience building and operating Temporal applications.

Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Temporal Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.

Temporal is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. If you need to request a reasonable accommodation, please let your Recruiter know so we can assist.
$140.8K – $231K • Offers Equity • Multiple Ranges
